create_MLGymEnv: create an MLGymEnv instance with EnvironmentArguments and device list to manage a Docker container for ML tasks
reset_MLGymEnv: reset the MLGym environment to initial state by rebuilding the container workspace and installing dependencies
step_MLGymEnv: execute one step in the MLGym environment by sending an action command to the container and returning the observation
communicate_MLGymEnv: send a shell command to the container and retrieve the output with configurable timeout durations
evaluate_MLGymEnv: evaluate a submission artifact by calling the task evaluate method and returning metrics and exit status
